descriptions.cloud-run-admin-jobs_create: Create a Cloud Run Job in a GCP project. Required: parent (format: projects/{project}/locations/{region}). Key optional: jobId (name for the job), validateOnly (dry-run validation), annotations. Returns a long-running operation — use operations_wait to poll for completion. Use this before cloud-run-admin-jobs_run when the job doesn't exist yet.
descriptions.cloud-run-admin-jobs_list: List Cloud Run Jobs in a project and region. Required: parent (format: projects/{project}/locations/{region}). Optional: pageSize (max results), pageToken (pagination cursor), showDeleted (include soft-deleted jobs). Returns job names, statuses, and metadata. Use cloud-run-admin-jobs_run to trigger an execution from a job returned here.
descriptions.cloud-run-admin-jobs_run: Trigger a new Execution of an existing Cloud Run Job. Required: name (full job resource name, e.g. projects/{project}/locations/{region}/jobs/{job}). Optional: etag (optimistic concurrency check), validateOnly (dry-run). Returns a long-running operation — use operations_wait to block until the execution completes. Prefer this over cloud-run-admin-jobs_create when the job already exists.
descriptions.cloud-run-admin-jobs_executions_list: List past Executions of a Cloud Run Job. Required: parent (full job resource name: projects/{project}/locations/{region}/jobs/{job}). Optional: pageSize, pageToken, showDeleted (include cancelled/deleted executions). Returns execution names, start times, completion status, and task counts. Use executions_tasks_list to drill into individual tasks from an execution returned here.
descriptions.executions_tasks_list: List individual Tasks within a specific Job Execution. Required: parent (full execution resource name: projects/{project}/locations/{region}/jobs/{job}/executions/{execution}). Optional: pageSize, pageToken, showDeleted. Returns task indices, start/completion times, and exit codes. Use this to diagnose which tasks in an execution failed.
descriptions.operations_list: List long-running operations for a given Cloud Run resource or location. Required: name (project or location path, e.g. projects/{project}/locations/{region}). Optional: filter (AIP-160 expression, e.g. 'done=false' for pending ops), pageSize, pageToken. Returns operation names, status, and metadata. Use operations_wait to block on a specific operation from this list.
descriptions.operations_wait: Block until a Cloud Run long-running operation completes or a timeout elapses. Required: name (full operation resource name returned by create/update/delete commands). Optional: timeout (duration string, e.g. '30s'; defaults to HTTP timeout). Returns the operation's final state including any error. Call this after cloud-run-admin-jobs_create, services_create, services_patch, or services_revisions_delete to confirm the operation succeeded before proceeding.
descriptions.services_create: Create a new Cloud Run Service in a GCP project and region. Required: parent (format: projects/{project}/locations/{region}). Key optional: serviceId (service name), validateOnly (dry-run), ingress, scaling, container image settings. Returns a long-running operation — use operations_wait to confirm completion. Use services_patch to update an existing service instead.
descriptions.services_get-iam-policy: Retrieve the current IAM policy for a Cloud Run Service (who has which roles). Required: resource (full service name: projects/{project}/locations/{region}/services/{service}). Optional: options.requestedPolicyVersion (policy schema version). Returns role-to-member bindings. Use services_set-iam-policy to update the policy, or services_test-iam-permissions to check specific permissions.
descriptions.services_list: List Cloud Run Services in a project and region. Required: parent (format: projects/{project}/locations/{region}). Optional: pageSize (max results), pageToken (pagination), showDeleted (include soft-deleted). Returns service names, URIs, latest revision, and traffic config. For multi-project fleet visibility, use the novel services list-all command instead.
descriptions.services_patch: Update an existing Cloud Run Service (image, scaling, env vars, ingress, etc.). Required: name (full service resource name: projects/{project}/locations/{region}/services/{service}). Key optional: allowMissing (upsert behavior), validateOnly, container image, CPU/memory limits, env vars, scaling. Returns a long-running operation — use operations_wait to confirm. Prefer this over services_create for updates to existing services.
descriptions.services_set-iam-policy: Replace the IAM policy on a Cloud Run Service. Required: resource (full service name: projects/{project}/locations/{region}/services/{service}). Key optional: policy-bindings (array of role/member pairs), policy-etag (optimistic lock), updateMask (limit which fields are overwritten). Returns the new policy. Warning: this overwrites all existing bindings — use services_get-iam-policy first to read the current policy before modifying.
descriptions.services_test-iam-permissions: Check which IAM permissions the caller holds on a Cloud Run Service, without modifying any state. Required: resource (full service name: projects/{project}/locations/{region}/services/{service}). Optional: permissions (list of permission strings to test, e.g. ['run.services.get', 'run.services.update']). Returns only the subset of requested permissions that the caller actually has.
descriptions.services_revisions_delete: Delete a specific Cloud Run Revision. Required: name (full revision name: projects/{project}/locations/{region}/services/{service}/revisions/{revision}). Optional: etag (optimistic concurrency), validateOnly (dry-run). Returns a long-running operation — use operations_wait to confirm. Revisions actively serving traffic cannot be deleted; use services_patch to shift traffic first.
descriptions.services_revisions_get: Retrieve detailed configuration and status for a specific Cloud Run Revision. Required: name (full revision name: projects/{project}/locations/{region}/services/{service}/revisions/{revision}). Returns container image, resource limits, env vars, creation time, and serving status. Use services_revisions_list to find valid revision names first.
descriptions.services_revisions_list: List Revisions for a Cloud Run Service or location. Required: parent (service path: projects/{project}/locations/{region}/services/{service}, or location path for all revisions in a region). Optional: pageSize, pageToken, showDeleted. Returns revision names, images, creation times, and traffic allocation. Use services_revisions_get for full config on a specific revision.
